coverage.finding: The folio number '151' with a superscript 'b' is at the top left. The candidate reading is confirmed.

Both lines are present. The first line ends at 'nimittāya', and the candidate line break is correct. The struck-through word before 'Adṛśya…' looks like an initial 'Ā' with a stroke through it, but it remains uncertain. One '[sic]' is interlinear above the overwritten ending of '…darśanādarśa…'. The other '[sic]' is written in brackets within 'praśnaś[sic]āro'. A fragment '…prāpti nimittāya' runs onto the left edge of the fol. 152 image at the level of b. 98 (1). This is consistent with the attachment by position.
The single line reads 'ff. 2-22, unf., chapters not numbered.' A left-pointing arrow is on the target side at about x≈3060–3165, y≈2920. The dash and tick to its right belong to fol. 152.

The holding entry is present. However, the right-hand column '1624: 8: 9: D' stands on the first line, after 'Tripāṭhin &'. It is not after the indented second line, so the literal line layout needs correcting. The middle of the title is still uncertain.
The indented second line 'Hiraṇyanātha Tripāṭhin' is correctly grouped with b004.

The entry, its query mark and the 'n.d.: 10: 8/10: D' column are confirmed. A left arrow is on the target side at about x≈3030. The right arrow at about x≈3195–3275 lies at or beyond the gutter and is treated as facing-page material.
There are faint marks ('. .2') near the gutter at y≈2660, level with 'See Pariśiṣṭa' on fol. 152. It is unclear whether they are ink or offset, so they are kept as uncertain.
These are dotted or dashed stray pen marks below b006, at x≈550 and x≈1470. They are non-text and are combined in one record, which is acceptable.
